metadata.description: NetConnect's Claude Code plugins — opinionated tooling for building, deploying, and operating NCI services.

plugins.name: golden-path
plugins.description: Walk a project through the NetConnect Golden Path's 10 checkpoints. Orchestrator skill + per-checkpoint skills + /golden-path:start slash command. Use to bootstrap a new NCI repo or add a single capability (Bunnyshell deploy, MCP, Keycloak SSO, etc.) to an existing one.

plugins.name: ssh-fleet
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code to the ssh-fleet MCP: fleet inventory, network devices, BMCs, observability and security integrations. Sign-in is Keycloak SSO with your NCI account; your rights follow your role.

plugins.name: network-operations
plugins.description: Investigation-first network operations through the ssh-fleet MCP. Adaptive depth (L0 lookup to L5 fleet-wide), competing hypotheses, contradiction handling, specialist subagents, and a change lifecycle (plan, approve, verify) that never turns an anomaly into a production change. Triggers on connectivity, routing, firewall/ACL, VPN, SIP/SBC, DNS, monitoring-gap and 'push/restart this' requests.
